digest.component_or_area: plan-review attestation validity and related-material pinning
propositions: Signed material pins must be validated across all plan-review attestation lifecycle consumers as a related-material validity check, with optional enforcement to enable safe rollout for existing projects.

Enabled pin drift (stale, missing, or malformed) must invalidate claim-gate, reuse, refresh, and re-sign outcomes; disabled enforcement must report the same conditions as advisory without changing the valid flag.
Configuration key enforce_plan_material_pins must support fail-open rollout on read errors, emitting structured warning plan_material_pin_config_unreadable without raising.
Unreadable or deleted pinned targets must produce stale-pin-missing status and emit structured warning plan_material_pin_target_unreadable without raising; archived targets remain readable.

Derived health must report pin status as current, stale-pin-drift, stale-pin-missing, malformed-pin, or legacy-unpinned, aggregated by fixed severity malformed-pin > stale-pin-missing > stale-pin-drift > current.

Pre-LLM review-time related_material must be serialized to sidecar as reviewed_related_material list, round-tripped through sidecar parse on re-sign recovery, and validated through the same health derivation without requiring a certified attestation.
